label: Amino acid, urea cycle and nitrogen metabolism
reason: Nearly all members are amino acid catabolism/biosynthesis, urea cycle defects, glutathione, sulfur amino acid and cofactor (B6, BH4) metabolism; few odd members (DNA protection).

label: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage and FA use
reason: Lipid droplet formation/disassembly, lipolysis, lipophagy, carnitine shuttle and FA oxidation regulation, plus adipocyte/adiponectin, form one fat-storage-and-mobilisation theme.

label: AKT-FOXO/p53 control of glycolytic metabolism
reason: FOXO/AKT regulation and p53/mTORC1 signalling linked to glycolysis/PPP control via fructose-2,6-bisphosphate (PFKFB, TIGAR) - a specific growth-signal-to-metabolism axis.

label: Amino acid and peptide membrane transport
reason: Members are SLC-mediated amino acid, oligopeptide and dipeptide transport and related transporter disorders; SLC22A18 is a lone outlier.

label: Mitochondrial respiratory chain and biogenesis
reason: OXPHOS complex assembly, electron transport, ATP synthase, Fe-S clusters, mitochondrial protein import/processing and cristae all serve mitochondrial respiration.

label: Nuclear RNA 3' processing and exosome decay
reason: tRNA/snRNA/snoRNA/rRNA 3'-end processing, 3'-5' exonucleolytic decay and nuclear RNA surveillance are all RNA exosome-centred processes.

label: Selective autophagy and autophagosome regulation
reason: Mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, CMA, microautophagy and autophagosome assembly/maturation regulation share one autophagy theme.

label: Endothelial differentiation and vascular development
reason: VEGF/VEGFR2, neuropilin, Tie2 signalling, endothelial fate, arterial/venous and lymphatic specification and vasculogenesis form one vascular theme.

label: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
reason: Endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signalling, HSE immunodeficiencies, TREX1 and cGAS-STING regulation all concern nucleic-acid sensing to type I IFN.

label: MECP2 regulation and neurobehavioural phenotypes
reason: MECP2 transcriptional regulation/Rett variants linked specifically to the behaviours its loss disrupts (locomotion, vocalisation, breathing control, social and sensory behaviour); a few odd members.

label: Phosphate homeostasis and biomineralisation
reason: Na/Pi cotransporters and their diseases, FGF23-Klotho/PTH regulation, ectopic calcification and bone/tooth mineralisation are one phosphate-mineral axis.

label: Cellular senescence and Polycomb silencing
reason: Oncogene-, stress- and replicative senescence, SAHF, SASP and Polycomb/BMI1 control of CDKN2A form one senescence programme.

label: Mitotic chromosome segregation and cytokinesis
reason: Chromosome condensation, cohesion, spindle assembly/checkpoint, cytokinesis and nuclear envelope reformation are all mitosis; C-MYC network a minor outlier.

label: DNA damage checkpoint, p53 and AKT
reason: G2 DNA-damage checkpoint and p53 regulation plus PI3K-AKT signalling, linked via AKT-MDM2 control of p53 stability and Cdc25/CDK checkpoint control.

label: K+ channels and neuronal membrane excitability
reason: Ca-activated and K2P potassium channels and regulation of resting potential, hyperpolarisation and action potentials form one excitability theme.

label: Hematopoiesis: erythroid, megakaryocyte, myeloid progenitors
reason: HSC homeostasis, RUNX1, erythroid/megakaryocyte/myeloid progenitor differentiation; only the TAK1/ATF module and generic BTMs stray.

label: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
reason: GABA, glutamate and glycine synthesis, reuptake, vesicular loading and related transporter diseases form one neurotransmitter-handling theme.

label: Nucleotide sugars and N-glycosylation disorders
reason: UDP-sugar synthesis and SLC35 transport, dolichol and N-glycan processing, and the corresponding CDGs are one glycosylation pathway.

label: ERBB/MET receptor tyrosine kinase signalling
reason: EGFR/ERBB2-4, MET, ALK/LTK and RON signalling through GRB2/SHC/PI3K/PLCG and RAS/ERK form one RTK signalling theme.

label: C-type lectin receptor antifungal innate immunity
reason: Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN signalling, antifungal responses and resulting IL-10/IL-12/IL-23/IFN-gamma production form one theme.

label: B cell development and BCR signalling
reason: B cell differentiation, proliferation, homeostasis and BCR signalling regulation dominate; two myeloid/inhibitory BTMs are a small minority.

label: One-carbon folate-methionine metabolism
reason: Folate interconversion, methionine cycle/salvage, SAM and remethylation defects, with selenium methylation and neural tube closure tied to the same pathway.

label: HIF/NRF2 stress control of glucose metabolism
reason: Hypoxia/HIF and NRF2 oxidative-stress transcription linked specifically to their metabolic targets (glycolysis, pentose phosphate, NADP+), with p53/mTORC1 metabolic regulation.

label: Activity-dependent synaptic plasticity and memory
reason: CaMK-CREB signalling, NPAS4, LTP/LTD, synaptic local translation and memory form one plasticity theme.

label: Rho GTPase actin cytoskeleton dynamics
reason: Rho/Rac/Cdc42 GTPase cycles and effectors, Arp2/3, filopodia/lamellipodia and actin capping/severing; erythrocyte maturation a lone outlier.

label: Glial development and CNS myelination
reason: Oligodendrocyte/astrocyte/Schwann differentiation and proliferation, glial fate and myelination regulation are one glial theme.

label: Germline development and epigenetic reprogramming
reason: Germ cell/spermatogonial and sperm chromatin processes plus piRNA, imprinting, X inactivation and DNA-methylation silencing, linked by germline epigenetic reprogramming.

label: Synaptic vesicle cycle and receptor trafficking
reason: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis/recycling, active zone and postsynaptic receptor trafficking form one synaptic membrane-trafficking theme.

label: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral interferon signalling
reason: RLR signalling, TRAF3/TRAF6-IRF and NF-kB activation, IFN-alpha/beta induction and viral evasion form one antiviral sensing theme.

label: SR calcium handling in muscle contraction
reason: Ryanodine receptor and SERCA regulation, NCX, sequestered calcium release and cardiac/skeletal contraction and relaxation form one excitation-contraction theme.

label: Mammary, prostate and reproductive tract development
reason: Mammary gland lineage/branching and prostate/genital tract morphogenesis linked by sex-steroid-driven branching glandular epithelial development.

label: Neutrophil recruitment and inflammatory activation
reason: Formyl peptide and complement receptor signalling, neutrophil chemotaxis, degranulation and myeloid inflammatory BTMs form one innate inflammation theme.

label: CYP and lipoxygenase fatty acid/eicosanoid oxidation
reason: Eicosanoid, hepoxilin, 12-HETE and linoleate metabolism, CYP fatty acid substrates and their defects, and FA/prostaglandin transport share one lipid-oxidation theme.

label: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion and spindle
reason: Condensation, cohesin loading/resolution, CENP-A deposition, PLK1/Aurora, spindle assembly and checkpoint are all mitosis.

label: Plasma membrane amino acid transport, aminoacidurias
reason: SLC amino acid transporters and their renal diseases (cystinuria, Hartnup, iminoglycinuria) plus transporter BTMs; urate transport a small outlier.

label: Viral RNA replication and host nucleic-acid restriction
reason: Coronavirus replication and host translation hijacking linked to host ADAR/APOBEC editing and replication restriction via the specific virus-host RNA interface; L13a silencing odd.

label: Cholesterol efflux, HDL and foam cells
reason: LXR-driven ABCA1 efflux, HDL assembly, reverse cholesterol transport, LDL handling and foam cell regulation form one cholesterol homeostasis theme.

label: Mast cell FcepsilonRI activation and hypersensitivity
reason: FCERI signalling, mast cell differentiation, degranulation, histamine release and type I hypersensitivity form one allergic effector theme.

label: Acetyl-CoA, NAD(P) and CoA cofactor metabolism
reason: PDH conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, CoA/pantothenate synthesis, NAD salvage/nicotinate and NADPH regeneration form one central-cofactor theme.

label: Cell cycle, DNA repair, RNA processing grab-bag
reason: Sample spans mitosis/meiosis, DNA repair, SUMO and histone methylation, RNA editing/decay, rRNA processing and mitochondrial translation with no single specific link.
